[[Eye of the North]] | pvp = Tamer | pvpreward = Basic (see note) | specialgallery = ranger Tamer Mask }} '''Ranger Tamer Mask''' is a mask art type introduced in the Prophecies campaign and is also available in the Factions campaign and Eye of the North expansion. This mask is available with a [[Beast Mastery]] [[attribute bonus]] for all masks with lower than max [[armor rating]].
